nodes.label: Highscore store file
nodes.sink: Highscore store parser and in-memory ranking

nodes.label: Level content
nodes.source: Level file or shared level source
nodes.untrusted_input: Locally edited or shared-server level data

nodes.label: Player name input
nodes.source: Game UI or configured player identity

nodes.failure_behavior: The store rejects and reports invalid records or storage failures while the menu remains usable with an empty or previously valid in-memory board.
nodes.label: A malformed or tampered highscore file could corrupt ranking data, expose unsafe resource usage, or prevent the menu from displaying the board.
nodes.task_relevance: The feature adds a persistent store that is read across runs.

nodes.failure_behavior: The integration records once at the level-end transition, using finalized run state; missing values are normalized before submission.
nodes.label: Recording before the level-end score calculation or after the level is reset could publish an inaccurate score, name, or elapsed time.
nodes.task_relevance: The requested record must reflect the actual completed or lost run.

nodes.failure_behavior: If a source value is missing or invalid at the integration point, use a stated safe default or normalized representation before calling the receiving operation, while still recording the run.
nodes.label: The operation that records a finished run must capture the finalized player points, player name, and elapsed survival time for both level clearing and loss, before run state is discarded or restarted.
nodes.task_relevance: Preserves the feature’s definition of a real run result.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject and report the invalid record without substituting, clamping, or partially inserting it.
nodes.label: The operation that receives a new highscore record must validate the score, survival time, and player name, including numeric ranges, name length and character constraints, and the mm:ss representation derived from the bounded elapsed time.
nodes.task_relevance: Prevents local input or corrupted state from creating invalid displayed records.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject malformed or inconsistent records and preserve the last valid collection state.
nodes.label: The highscore store must keep player name, score, and survival time as one record and sort records by score descending without allowing parallel lists to become misaligned.
nodes.task_relevance: Maintains correct identity-to-result association and the requested ranking order.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject and report records or input exceeding the configured limits; retain valid records already loaded and keep the menu operational.
nodes.label: The store must impose a finite maximum number of records and a finite input size when loading persisted data, so a locally edited file cannot cause unbounded memory or rendering work.
nodes.task_relevance: Keeps the desktop game responsive while loading and displaying the board.

nodes.failure_behavior: If loading fails, display an empty or last valid board with a clear failure indication rather than crashing or blocking normal menu navigation.
nodes.label: The menu must expose the highscore board through a dedicated panel or view, render names together with descending scores and survival times, and load persisted data before the view is displayed.
nodes.task_relevance: Provides the requested user-visible menu integration and cross-run behavior.

nodes.failure_behavior: Return failure and leave the board unchanged; do not clamp or invent a value.
nodes.label: At the receiving operation for a new record, use strict validation for null names, name size and characters, nonnegative bounded scores, and nonnegative bounded elapsed times; report rejection explicitly.
nodes.task_relevance: Implements R2 at the store boundary.

nodes.failure_behavior: The run is still submitted with the stated defaults; the receiving operation remains strict and may report other invalid input.
nodes.label: At the level-end integration point, normalize a missing player name to a defined local default and normalize missing or invalid elapsed-time presentation before invoking the record operation.
nodes.task_relevance: Implements R1 while preserving the primary recording effect.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject inconsistent persisted records and preserve the prior valid collection.
nodes.label: At the store boundary, represent each result as an atomic record and update ranking through one bounded collection so name, score, and survival time are inserted, sorted, and exposed together.
nodes.task_relevance: Implements R3 without relying on independently mutable lists.

nodes.failure_behavior: Stop processing the offending input, report the rejection, and retain valid entries already accepted.
nodes.label: At persistence loading, read through a bounded-size mechanism, cap the number of decoded entries, and avoid unsafe deserialization or executable content facilities.
nodes.task_relevance: Implements R4 for the locally editable store file.

nodes.failure_behavior: Report persistence or refresh failure, keep the current valid board available, and continue normal game or menu navigation.
nodes.label: At menu-panel initialization and level-end integration, load or refresh the store before rendering, and invoke recording exactly once for each terminal clear-or-loss transition before any restart or menu navigation.
nodes.task_relevance: Implements R1 and R5 across the game loop and menu flow.

summary: High-level guidance for integrating a bounded, validated, persistent highscore store with ApoMario’s level-end flow and menu-panel navigation.
